piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS, Sukrut Stretches the Lead
piece.big_picture: 15 of 24 managers captained Haaland. He scored 2, so 4 each with the armband. The best of the 9 who went elsewhere: Pradnyesh with Tavernier, 16 with the armband. Rocket: Aryamann (Up 3). Now 4th.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Atharva Kshirsagar picked the wrong 11 and left 36 points on the bench. The biggest bench loss of the week. The squad was fine, the team sheet was not.
piece.one_to_watch: Shantanu and Pradnyesh are 8 points apart at the Tin Pot line. One good week from Shantanu could swap them over.

winners.name: Aryamann
winners.verdict: Wirtz and Evanilson in, Mbeumo and Kostoulas out. The swap paid 18 points. Gold spots are in reach now.

winners.name: Pradnyesh
winners.verdict: The only manager to back Tavernier with the armband. 16 points with the armband, and that was pure nerve. Bold, brave and paid for.

winners.name: Arya
winners.verdict: Started A.Becker when nobody else did, and he returned 7 points. One lone pick, and it landed.

losers.name: Aryan
losers.verdict: Brought in McGinn and Dasilva and took a hit for it. The swap cost 6 points. Bad call.

losers.name: Aary
losers.verdict: A hit for 3 new faces, then Lewis-Potter scored 16 after being sold. Rotten luck, though the hit was a gamble that failed.

losers.name: Anuj
losers.verdict: Out of the Gold spots after a selection week to forget. Third a few weeks back, now 5th.

ratings.l: 5 weeks above average. The Rocket suits this run.
